DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: What do i need to do again?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: What do i need to do again?

Message.SourceString: I need you to find these agents. Observe their disguises and report back to me. For each one you observe you'll gain a coin, return to me and I can trade them in for useful stuff!
Message.LocalizedString: I need you to find these agents. Observe their disguises and report back to me. For each one you observe you'll gain a coin, return to me and I can trade them in for useful stuff!

Message.SourceString: Go! Put a stop to the penguin menace before it's too late!
Message.LocalizedString: Go! Put a stop to the penguin menace before it's too late!

Message.SourceString: Agents of the KGP have already infiltrated Ashenfall. Even now they're observing what you do and plotting ways to take us all down.
Message.LocalizedString: Agents of the KGP have already infiltrated Ashenfall. Even now they're observing what you do and plotting ways to take us all down.

Message.SourceString: Our sources tell us that the agents rotate out every week, spread across the entire continent, and limit themselves to only six active agents at any one time. They could be disguised as anything - barrels, bushes, unusually large bees.

Message.SourceString: What? Huh? That's not a thing. Who recruited you? Terry? I bet it was Terry, he never tells people nothing.
Message.LocalizedString: What? Huh? That's not a thing. Who recruited you? Terry? I bet it was Terry, he never tells people nothing.

Message.SourceString: Only owls know the secret song in summer. Don't you agree comrad.... err... friend?
Message.LocalizedString: Only owls know the secret song in summer. Don't you agree comrad.... err... friend?

Message.SourceString: Ok, look. You know why you're here. You know what's at stake.
Message.LocalizedString: Ok, look. You know why you're here. You know what's at stake.

Message.SourceString: Good. Great. Penguins! The most dangerous force across all of Gielinor. Dragons? HA! Don't make me laugh, the penguins are the real threat here and they'll DESTROY US ALL!
